oracle.trainable: one unconstrained fp32 DreamLite model-space latent tensor
oracle.initialization: posterior-mean VAE encoding of exact uniform RGB 127/255
oracle.decode: unchanged frozen DreamLite VAE, model-latent scale/shift, unit RGB clamp

choice_views.training: four forward-cyclic views, exactly 64 exposures each

locked_interpretation.latent_8: The VAE state representation can carry readable codes. Replace the semantic DreamLite editor with a direct event-to-latent writer, then require shared held-out F1 success.
locked_interpretation.latent_1_to_7: VAE-space readability is target-dependent. Attribute fixed target/token properties before designing a shared writer.
locked_interpretation.latent_0: The readable codes found by direct pixels are outside the demonstrated VAE-decodable region. Bypass or augment the VAE with an image-space residual codec.
locked_interpretation.technical_failure: Rerun only invalid targets in fresh roots and make no scientific inference from them.

success_boundary.formal_success_still_requires: shared learned writing, held-out ID/OOD evaluation, multiple seeds, recurrence, and causal state controls
